description: Op-shaped job that walks the live Dagster asset graph and emits one OpenLineage RunEvent per asset to a collector (Marquez, OpenLineage Proxy, Datakin).

tags.label: Job Tags
tags.description: Dagster job tags as key-value pairs.

endpoint_env_var.label: Endpoint Env Var
endpoint_env_var.description: Env var with the OpenLineage collector base URL (e.g. http://marquez:5000). The job appends /api/v1/lineage if no path is set.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var with a bearer token if the collector requires auth.

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.description: OpenLineage namespace. All datasets and jobs from this code location group under this string.

producer.label: Producer URI
producer.description: OpenLineage producer URI identifying the emitter.

only_export_on_change.label: Only Export on Change
only_export_on_change.description: Hash the structural payload (plus column lineage) and skip emit when unchanged from the previous successful run.

fail_on_collector_error.label: Fail on Collector Error
fail_on_collector_error.description: If True, any collector POST failure fails the run (checked after every event has been attempted, not at the first failure -- with max_concurrent_requests>1 there is no single 'first' failure to stop at). Default False (best-effort emit).

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: 'code_location' (current location's asset graph) or 'deployment' (full Dagster+ graph via GraphQL, same mechanism as lineage_graph_extractor). Falls back to 'code_location' automatically if Dagster+ env vars aren't set or the GraphQL query fails.

dagster_plus_token_env.label: Dagster Plus Token Env
dagster_plus_token_env.description: Env var holding a Dagster+ user token (only used for scope='deployment').

max_concurrent_requests.label: Max Concurrent Requests
max_concurrent_requests.description: Max concurrent POSTs to the collector. The OpenLineage HTTP transport (Marquez's /api/v1/lineage) accepts one event per request -- there is no standard batch endpoint to send many events in one call -- so concurrency, not batching, is the real export-throughput lever for a large asset graph. Set to 1 for strictly sequential POSTs.

emit_column_lineage.label: Emit Column Lineage
emit_column_lineage.description: Emit a real OpenLineage columnLineage facet on each asset's output dataset, built from its most recent materialization's `dagster/column_lineage` metadata (e.g. set by sql_transform's own column_lineage: field), when present. Requires one extra instance.get_asset_records(...) call per export; set False to skip it.

retry_max_attempts.label: Retry Max Attempts
retry_max_attempts.description: Max attempts per event POST. Retries a connection failure/timeout or a 5xx response (both plausibly transient); a 4xx fails immediately without retrying (a malformed event or bad auth won't fix itself by resending). Set to 1 to disable retries entirely.

retry_backoff_seconds.label: Retry Backoff Seconds
retry_backoff_seconds.description: Base delay between retry attempts; doubles each attempt (1s, 2s, 4s, ...).
